data.name: Swara
data.gender_notes: Swara is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit svara, 'sound, tone, a musical note'. Its root is Sanskrit svar (स्वर्). A classical Sanskrit term for a musical note. Swara is a Sanskrit name meaning “A musical note; sound; tone”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Swara expresses “A musical note; sound; tone”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit svara, 'sound, tone, a musical note'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Swara total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

vedic_reference.note: Swara is a Sanskrit term that refers to the seven musical notes in Indian classical music, as well as the melodic vibrations of the cosmos. In Hindu mythology, Swara is also associated with the seven divine voices of the Vedas.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for a musical note.
